report_figure_layout.canvas_policy: Fixed physical width; no tight-bbox rescaling. Phase2 splits at 13 arms with common x ranges. Each long-run metric/histogram is a separate figure. Fonts are checked after fitting both report width and height.

phase1_relative_metrics.height_limit_warning: Any additional height fitting must retain at least the declared minimum display dimensions.

phase2_equal_exposure.height_limit_warning: Any additional height fitting must retain at least the declared minimum display dimensions.

aggregation: GEN mean within TRAIN; equally weighted independent TRAIN mean/sample SD; no GEN-as-TRAIN N.
missing_observation_policy: Skip missing/unpaired cells; no padding, imputation or extrapolation. See each stage's status and missing lists.

comparison.comparison_basis: EXACT same observed exposure and evaluation cohort; different B/update reference allowed, never described as same update
